hero_headline: Fix the statutory gap. Allow kei vehicle registration.
hero_subhead: Illinois is treating lawfully imported kei vehicles as off-highway, so owners cannot register them for normal road use. You can help fix it—contact your legislator with a pre-written script in under a minute.
advocacy_hero_headline: Find your legislators. Build support for the Kei vehicle registration.
advocacy_hero_headline_line2: Build support for the Kei registration fix
advocacy_hero_subhead_line1: We're building constituent support and identifying a sponsor.
advocacy_hero_subhead_line2: No bill yet — your rep needs to hear from you now so we're ready when legislation moves.
one_pager_points: Kei vehicles are federally legal to import (25-year rule).
21+ states already allow registration—Illinois is the outlier.
The current Illinois statute has an ambiguity, not a prohibition.
The fix is a narrow clarifying amendment—no new regulatory framework.
This affects real Illinois residents who own legal vehicles they can't register.
